title: Casamo: From my own apartment search to a product for other travelers
description: I designed, built, and operate Casamo, a live product that checks Airbnb and Booking.com listings against a traveler's requirements and shows the evidence behind each finding.
seoTitle: Casamo Case Study | Building a Production AI Product
seoDescription: How I built and operate Casamo: evidence-based stay research, durable searches, credit recovery, and authenticated AI client access.
constraints: The product needed a narrower promise than broad AI travel planning.
Marketplace filters could not prove that a furnished stay would support several weeks of living and working.
The report needed to show uncertainty without filling the shortlist with weak matches.
problem: Remote workers booking 2–8 week furnished stays make an expensive decision from marketplace data that may be incomplete. A listing can claim Wi-Fi, workspace, kitchen, or laundry without showing whether those details will support daily life.
Casamo needed to check those claims.
solution: Designed destination search and comparison of 2–10 listing links, with separate required and preferred criteria.
Built AI audits of listing facts, reviews, and photos, with shared eligibility rules and source evidence in the report.
Added list, map, and comparison views, saved-evidence reranking, host questions, and trip-grounded Q&A.
Moved scans into durable Cloudflare Workflows with persisted stage artifacts, repeat-safe starts, and credit restoration.
Built accounts, Stripe plans, and hosted MCP access with user consent and server-side revocation.
result: Live product with public signup, saved trips, one free eligible search, a One-Day Pass, and monthly plans.
One September 5 production acceptance run discovered 262 listings and displayed ten qualified stays in nine minutes, with one debit and a sent completion email.
September 8 production checks verified Claude Code and Codex authorization, private trip reads, reversible annotations, and revocation.
deliveryHighlights: Live product: design, application, AI pipeline, billing, and operations

Durable scans, saved-evidence reranking, and credit restoration
